description: This file defines the 'Manufacturer' class within the Opencart admin controller namespace. It contains methods that add background tasks related to manufacturer operations such as adding, editing, and deleting manufacturers, including associated products. The class interacts with models for task management, catalog products, and the system engine.

classes.name: Manufacturer
classes.description: Controller class for handling manufacturer-related events in the admin area, specifically to enqueue background tasks when manufacturers are added, edited, or deleted.

methods.name: addManufacturer
methods.description: Adds background tasks for listing manufacturers and updating information when a new manufacturer is added.

methods.name: editManufacturer
methods.description: Adds tasks to refresh manufacturer list, update manufacturer info, and associated products when a manufacturer is edited.

methods.name: deleteManufacturer
methods.description: Schedules tasks to update the manufacturer list, remove manufacturer data, and refresh related products when a manufacturer is deleted.
